name: Carmen Kapoor
life: “I still remember being passed over because my old letters were in another language.” People around Breakwater Way know Carmen by a small Saturday habit. Carmen stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I used to accept cash so nobody asked about my papers. I want the union to hear me without promising miracles.
appearance: Carmen has a center part and straight chestnut hair, a wide brow and a narrow jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a striped cotton shirt. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Carmen folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing.
personality: Carmen admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Carmen learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To get a protected hearing from the union.
family: Sofia Valdez is Carmen’s cousin. Carmen makes room at the table. Sofia brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The high road home*, Sofia says, “I can tell when the driver is scared because the radio gets louder.”
connections: Wynn Kapoor. Both need usable wage records, one for family support and one for work done unofficially.

reactions.response: Carmen asks that the offer be written down with the remaining unpaid hours.
